title: Patch: every Core card drawn as what it is: a scene of its own for each, richer the rarer
notes: Core's picture pass under #3330, on #3331's art bible and scene kits. Every Core entry but Ceaseless Void (core-100, whose picture #3338 owns), 99 cards and 11 tokens, now draws a scene recipe of its own, written from its brief in the issue's table (sceneRecipesCore1.ts to sceneRecipesCore3.ts), on the base and the Radiant face, at or above its rarity's detail floor: every one is off the short list, whose cap drops from 561 to 453. A Unit's character is a figure from the figure kit or a creature part, never the painter's silhouette; the kits gained the parts the briefs named, and a scene may stand more figures than one (its cast). Speciesist and Heroic Power are redrawn from their new briefs, and the seven full-art Core cards that moved their props move their scene's near layer instead (R3392000). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Every Core card drawn as a scene of its own
changes: Every Core card now shows a scene of its own, drawn from what the card is: simpler on a Common, richer the rarer the card, up to a set piece on each Mythic.
Ceaseless Void keeps its picture. Nothing plays differently.
